The t-quadratic discriminant is ℓ²(r−1)²(2ℓ+r+1)²(r²−6r+1), so no negative values when r≤3+2sqrt2. For r above barrier, roots t± cross physical cosine interval at L_−,L_+ with t−>−1; arcsine angle density gives the three probability cases. Root monotonicity and exact derivative-sign identity show strict rise to L_+ and strict fall thereafter.
